title: 80% Of Animal Species Are Insects
hook: Eight of every ten animal species are insects.
closing: Most insects remain unnamed, so we barely know the planet's dominant animals.
question: What is the strangest insect you've seen?

segments.say: Roughly eight of every ten animal species are insects, making bugs the animal majority.
Beetles alone have about 1.5 million species, dwarfing mammals and birds combined.
Only about one in five insect species has been named, leaving most of the majority unknown.
